name: tralogfin
description: TraLogFin: Track a Day, Log a Ticket and Find a Link. One folder, two repositories in the TraLogFin organization: front-end and back-end (both private).
//: Shared by both repositories: launch, deploy and abort only. Each side's own scripts live in its package.json: sync:frontend in source/layouts/, sync:backend, server:* and guard:* in source/modules/ (EDITOR.md, The Scripts). prepare runs on its own after every npm install: it installs the guards as Git hooks, so no computer can commit without them. prelaunch runs on its own before launch: it writes the .git file (gitdir: .frontend.git) when it is missing, so Source Control finds the front end again

scripts.prelaunch: node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(!fs.existsSync('.git')&&fs.existsSync('.frontend.git')){fs.writeFileSync('.git','gitdir: .frontend.git\n');console.log('|--🠊 Guidance: .git was missing, written again so VS Code sees the front end, prelaunch 🠈--|')}"

author: Tertius Roach and Johann Schoeman
